html: This would make a strange coincidence as well. If Shehbaz Sharif or Bilawal (or anyone else than Imran Khan) were to become PM in 2023, and then be overthrown in 2027 by a General, it would parallel with Zulfikar Ali Bhutto, he became PM in 1973, and was overthrown in 1977 by a general. Bonus coincidence if the overthrown PM is executed or killed a few years after 2027, as that would parallel with Bhutto's own execution
